title: HUANUO Dual Monitor Stand, Fully Adjustable Gaming Monitor Desk Mount for 13–32″ Computer Screens, Full Motion VESA 75x75/100x100 with C-Clamp & Grommet Base, Each Arm Holds 4.4 to 19.8 lbs

reviews.title: Super easy to install, very easy to use, fairly stable.
reviews.body: This dual monitor stand worked really well for my setup and was fairly easy to assemble. The instructions were clear enough that the whole installation only took a short time, and all the necessary mounting hardware was included.The build feels solid and stable, even with two monitors attached, and the gas-spring arms move smoothly without sagging. It is simple to adjust height, tilt, and rotation, so getting both screens aligned at a comfortable viewing angle is quick.The stand also helps keep the desk tidy, thanks to the built-in cable management and the way it frees up space under the monitors. Overall, it is a great value if you want a sturdy, flexible dual-monitor arm that is easy to put together and adjust.
reviews.author: Miguel Mateo

reviews.title: Great product for mon
reviews.body: I bought it in 2021 and I want to give a review after a year of using.I have read people issue and one thing I feel like they misunderstand the product is the arms keep falling down because of weight of monitor. I use two 27” MSI curve monitors and have no issue with it. I tighten the joint that closest to monitor using allen key provided (there are screw adjustment of tightness) and also every pivot point has screw adjustment and you can use allen key provided to tight it.I have not tried 32” monitor but I think this mount can handle the weight, maybe just one monitor as both 2 arms may not stretch out for the width of two 32” monitors.So, I recommend this product for two 27” monitors or smaller, if you need two monitors on this mount.

reviews.title: Check your desk shape first
reviews.body: Great dual monitor stand!Just be careful that your desk allows one of the two attachment methods. The three sided knob for tightening the clamp caught on part of my desk, meaning I could not easily tighten it on.
reviews.date: Reviewed in South Africa on 28 February 2026
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Just what I wanted!
reviews.body: I don’t even have to say nothing because huanuo is a great brand and speaks volumes for itself but let me just say this I was mind blown such an amazing and sturdy product for the price I thought I’d get something that was difficult to set up which this is not it’s super easy and or made of cheap material which this also is not it’s great sturdy and even heavier which shows you it’s good material! This only thing I don’t like is the maneuverability of moving the monitor left and right as the bracket only allows foward and downward tilt but that is easy to get over you can use this for a top and bottom setup because of the way the arms are but this it perfect for side by side! The size is good doesn’t take up much desk space but creates a lot more since it keeps your monitors looking like they are floating it gives an amazing look to your setup that’s for sure!! The wire management is also pretty good and is easy to use making look nice and clean but if you have fatter cords I would just remove the plastic piece and screw and zip tie it tot he arm instead as i did for my main monitor!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 15 July 2026

features: Compatible with Wide Screens - To ensure compatibility with the dual monitor mount, your each monitor must meet three conditions at the same time: First, computer screens size range: 13 to 32 inches. Second, screen weight range: 4.4 to 19.8 lbs. Third, the back of the monitor screen must have VESA mounting holes with a pitch of 75x75mm or 100x100mm.

Regarding the compatibility with desks - Your desk must meet three conditions at the same time: First, desk material: Only wooden desks are recommended, plastic or glass desks cannot be used. Second, desk thickness range: 0.59" - 3.54". Third, the bottom of the desk should not have any cross beams or panels, as this will interfere with installation. We recommend carefully checking that your desk and monitors meets all above conditions before purchasing.

Dual C-Clamp Hold - Worried your dual monitors might wobble or slip? Our upgraded base uses a larger platform plus a dual C-clamp structure to lock the dual monitor arm firmly to your desk. Each arm safely keeps your screens steady while you type, click and game—no shaking, no sliding, just a clean and secure setup you can trust every day. It also provides Grommet Mounting installation choice, both options ensure stable and secure fixation for your 0.59" - 3.54" desk.

Full-Motion Adjustment For Comfortable View - Pull the screen closer when you’re deep in a spreadsheet, push it back to watch videos, or rotate to portrait for coding — moving everything smoothly with just one hand. The monitor stand offers +85°/-50° tilt, ±90° swivel and 360° rotation. Raise your monitor up to 15.75″ to support a healthy sitting posture. Whether you’re working from home, gaming through the night, or switching between video calls and documents, getting the screens to your natural line of sight helps relieve neck, shoulder and back strain so you can stay focused longer with less fatigue.

Keep Your Desk Organized: By lifting both screens off the desktop, this dual monitor stand opens up valuable space for your keyboard, notebook, docking station or a simple, clutter-free work area. Built-in cable management guides wires along the arms, keeping cords out of sight and out of the way. Enjoy a tidy, modern workstation that looks as good as it feels to use.
